summary_md: **DailyPapers ([@HuggingPapers](https://x.com/HuggingPapers/status/2115898698337013877))** shares **TAO** ([paper](https://paperswithcode.co/paper/2610.37230)), an agentic-serving scheduler that pauses sessions during tool calls, scores them by time-decayed KV-cache credit and tool-return readiness, and places them via async DP, cutting latency up to 26.8% and mean TTFT up to 36.3% with under 0.12% overhead.

referenced_urls.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving | Papers with Code

relevance: Serving optimization for tool-heavy agent workloads.
